نحرنفز (form IIIq)
# نَحْرَنْفِزُ (naḥranfizu) /naħ.ran.fi.zu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْرَنْفَزَ (iḥranfaza)
# نَحْرَنْفِزَ (naḥranfiza) /naħ.ran.fi.za/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْرَنْفَزَ (iḥranfaza)
# نَحْرَنْفِزْ (naḥranfiz) /naħ.ran.fiz/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِحْرَنْفَزَ (iḥranfaza)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
